title: ENVOYS OF SIX NATIONS PRESENT CREDENTIALS TO THE PRESIDENT OF INDIA
body_text:
The President of India, Smt Droupadi Murmu accepted credentials from the envoys  of  South Sudan, United Arab Emirates, Nigeria, Moldova, Germany and Sweden at a ceremony held at Rashtrapati Bhavan today (August 24, 2026).
Those who presented their credentials were:
1.   H.E. Mrs. Sitona Abdalla Osman, Ambassador of the Republic of South Sudan
2.   H.E. Mr. Abdulla Saif Ali Slayem Al Nuaimi, Ambassador of the United Arab Emirates
3.   H.E. Mr. Muhammad Saidu Dahiru, High Commissioner of the Federal Republic of Nigeria
4.   H.E. Mrs. Inga Ionesii, Ambassador of the Republic of Moldova
5.   H.E. Dr. Jasper Wieck, Ambassador of the Federal Republic of Germany
6.   H.E. Ms. Petra Menander, Ambassador of Sweden
***
